title: U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike
summary: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the Fed not to embrace a bigger rate hike as Citi and traders still see a quarter-point move in December and bitcoin fell below $60,000. This post U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
